sql: SELECT 'sininho' AS onde, min(n.created_at)::text AS quando, n.title || ' | ' || n.message AS detalhe, count(*)::text AS qtd, max(n.data->>'event_id') AS festa, max(n.data->>'lead_id') AS lead FROM notifications n WHERE n.type = 'vamu_order' AND n.created_at > now() - interval '2 days' GROUP BY n.title, n.message UNION ALL SELECT 'historico', h.created_at::text, h.new_value, '1', null, h.lead_id::text FROM lead_history h WHERE h.action = 'Pedido Vamu 3D' AND h.created_at > now() - interval '2 days' UNION ALL SELECT 'festa', e.updated_at::text, e.title || ' | ' || right(e.internal_notes, 160), '1', e.id::text, e.lead_id::text FROM company_events e WHERE e.internal_notes ILIKE '%#vamu-%' ORDER BY 2
